related.title: LayerNorm：特徵軸與逐樣本正規化
related.titleEn: LayerNorm: feature axes and per-example normalization
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付統計軸、狀態切換與running統計恢復測試。；兩值吻合，母體/樣本變異慣例明示，eval批次不變性測試通過。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver reduction axes,state-switching and running-stat restoration tests.; Values match, variance convention is explicit and evaluation batch-invariance tests pass.
related.difference: 畫batch×token×feature張量，圈出每個token的feature軸；禁止把不同token一起歸約。；兩值在1e−8內吻合，平移及批次獨立性成立，歸約軸明確。
related.differenceEn: Draw batch×token×feature and circle each token’s feature axis; do not normalize different tokens together.; Values agree within1e−8, shift/batch invariances hold and reduction axes are explicit.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: y=γ(x−μ)/√(variance+ε)+β；統計軸與訓練/推論狀態必須明確。；教學同通道兩值2,4，均值3、母體變異1；取x4,ε1e−5,β0,γ1，再改γ2。；y=1/√1.00001=.9999950000；γ2時1.9999900001。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: y=gamma(x−mean)/sqrt(variance+epsilon)+beta; define reduction axes and train/eval state.; Teaching values2,4 have mean3 and population variance1; x4,epsilon1e−5,beta0,gamma1 then2.; y=1/sqrt1.00001=.9999950000; gamma2 gives1.9999900001.

For[1,2,3],mean2 and population variance2/3 give final standardized feature1/sqrt(2/3+epsilon).; Teaching epsilon1e−5,gamma1,beta0; change the final feature’s gamma to2.; y=1/sqrt(2/3+.00001)=1.224735686; changed result2.449471372.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: A100 TF32／BF16：動態範圍與有效位元
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付統計軸、狀態切換與running統計恢復測試。；兩值吻合，母體/樣本變異慣例明示，eval批次不變性測試通過。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver reduction axes,state-switching and running-stat restoration tests.; Values match, variance convention is explicit and evaluation batch-invariance tests pass.
related.difference: 分開指數範圍與尾數解析度，能解釋不溢位的結果仍可能失去小變化。
related.differenceEn: Separate exponent range and significand resolution, explaining loss of small changes without overflow.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: y=γ(x−μ)/√(variance+ε)+β；統計軸與訓練/推論狀態必須明確。；教學同通道兩值2,4，均值3、母體變異1；取x4,ε1e−5,β0,γ1，再改γ2。；y=1/√1.00001=.9999950000；γ2時1.9999900001。
二進位正規數在 [1,2) 的間距為 2^(−p)，p 是顯式小數位；最近捨入最大誤差為半間距。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 以 p=10 與 p=7 的教學格式比較，固定 x 在 [1,2)，不含次正規數、飽和及累加誤差。 p=10 時半間距=2^(−11)=0.00048828125；這是單次捨入的絕對誤差上界。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: y=gamma(x−mean)/sqrt(variance+epsilon)+beta; define reduction axes and train/eval state.; Teaching values2,4 have mean3 and population variance1; x4,epsilon1e−5,beta0,gamma1 then2.; y=1/sqrt1.00001=.9999950000; gamma2 gives1.9999900001.

For normalized binary values in [1, 2), spacing is 2^(−p) for p fraction bits; nearest rounding bounds error by half a spacing. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Compare teaching formats p=10 and p=7 for x in [1, 2), excluding subnormals, saturation and accumulation error. For p=10, half spacing=2^(−11)=0.00048828125, an absolute bound for one rounding.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
